summary: The FBI confirms it is investigating a break-in at its national crime database, but has not said who did it or what was taken. Stocks swung hard today on AI worries and inflation data, then mostly recovered. Bitcoin is near 58,000 dollars. No official source links these events.

events.title: FBI investigating break-in at its national crime database
events.impact: Police use this database to check warrants, stolen cars and missing people. The FBI has not said what was taken or if police lost access. No public sign that records were changed.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Patel confirmed an active investigation Tuesday and said the matter is ongoing. No attacker has been named or claimed it.

events.title: Wild swing in US stocks: Nasdaq fell 4.6% early, then recovered
events.impact: Close: S&P 500 7,182.78 (-0.25%), Dow 50,182.95 (+0.33%), Nasdaq 23,585.80 (-0.62%). Early lows were far worse. One report says the Nasdaq-100 briefly fell 20% from its peak. I found no trading halts.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite AI profit worries, hot inflation data (PCE) and new tariff plans. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported.

events.title: Bitcoin near 58-59K USD, down about 6-9% on the week
events.impact: Price check: Coinbase 58,651 (-1.3% on the day, -6% on the week); Coinglass 58,244 (-3.5% on the day). CoinGecko shows about 60,169. Sources differ a little. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Commentary points to hot inflation data and general selling of risky assets.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation systems were shut down. As of a Nov 24 report, USDA has not said if all systems are back or if financial data was taken.
events.stated_cause: A USDA official said systems were shut down over a cyber threat and no personal data was lost. No attacker is named.

events.title: Reported separate breach of CIA and intelligence office network
events.impact: Said to involve an unclassified open-source analysis network. Full scope is unknown.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Unnamed sources say it happened the same day as the FBI incident. I found no agency statement and no second independent source.

events.title: More tanker attacks near Strait of Hormuz
events.impact: Iran's Guards say two more tankers hit mines Wednesday. Monday, three ships were hit by unidentified projectiles. Brent is about 90 dollars and has fallen over the month, so markets are not panicking.
events.stated_cause: Iran says mines. The UK maritime office says unidentified projectiles. Iranian claims are not independently verified.

events.title: CISA adds 10 more actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Nov 25 additions cover Danfoss, HPE Juniper, Mitel and Vates products. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the FBI, CIA or USDA incidents.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows reduced performance on Sites and Services
events.impact: Cloudflare's status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 20:08 UTC today. I found no news report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI, CIA and USDA incidents are cyber break-ins, but no one has named an attacker or said how they got in. The stock drop is blamed on AI worries, inflation data and tariffs, and the tanker attacks on the Iran conflict. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company for the government breaches, or several big systems like banks, airlines and exchanges failing at the same time.

alert.reason: No confirmed outage or attack beyond the ongoing government breaches. Market swings have clear stated causes and recovered.

prep_note: No action needed for most people. Keep some cash on hand in case a card or app glitches, and watch official FBI and USDA updates. Farmers waiting on USDA loans or payments should call their local FSA office. Check financial accounts for odd activity.
